nodes.description: Public view function that validates a transfer by comparing _from and _to against hardcoded whitelisted addresses; returns true for the whitelisted pair, false otherwise, and true for any other sender.
Address parameter representing the sender of the transfer; only used in an equality comparison against a hardcoded address.
Address parameter representing the recipient of the transfer; compared against a hardcoded address when _from matches the whitelisted address.
Unsigned integer amount of the transfer; declared but never read or used inside the function body.

edges.reason: The parameter _from flows into the function verifyTransfer and is consumed by the address equality check that governs the branch and return value.
The parameter _to flows into the function verifyTransfer and is consumed by the nested address equality check determining the returned boolean.
The parameter _amount is passed into verifyTransfer but is never read, so it carries no effective data dependency beyond the call boundary.
